preferences.name: early_rb
preferences.guidance: Prefer at least one RB by the end of Round 2; do not leave Round 3 without an RB; prefer two RBs through Round 3 when the board supports it.
preferences.exception: Do not pass materially superior tier/value solely to satisfy the preferred construction.

preferences.name: wait_qb
preferences.guidance: Prefer to wait on premium quarterbacks rather than taking them at normal cost.
preferences.exception: Take an early QB when the value fall is unusually large and the RB/WR/TE opportunity cost is modest.

preferences.name: elite_te
preferences.guidance: Be willing to take an elite or top-tier TE when the value is strong.
preferences.exception: Do not materially compromise the strong early-RB preference unless the TE value advantage is substantial.

preferences.name: defense_timing
preferences.guidance: Prefer to have DEF filled by the end of Round 13 and consider acting earlier when a premium option or an observed defense run makes waiting unattractive.
preferences.exception: This is a soft timing preference, not a reason to ignore a materially superior alternative.

preferences.name: kicker_timing
preferences.guidance: Prefer to have K filled by the end of Round 14 and consider acting earlier for premium value or an observed kicker run.
preferences.exception: This is a soft timing preference, not a reason to ignore a materially superior alternative.
